recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of a man in 1970s attire, featuring a dynamic reaching gesture that creates depth through foreshortening against a dark, vignetted background.
coreVisualRelationships: The outstretched hand in the foreground creates a sense of physical proximity to the viewer.
The warm orange and mustard tones of the vest and trousers contrast against the cool blue plaid jacket.
The top-left alignment of the text balances the weight of the subject's head on the right.
coreInvariants: Dark, low-key background with a subtle floor gradient
High-contrast studio lighting emphasizing facial features and fabric textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered but leaning right; the reaching hand occupies the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the reaching hand form a diagonal axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the reaching hand, moves up the arm to the face, and then to the typography in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space surrounds the subject, focusing all attention on the figure and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject's clothing and the dark background; muted saturation overall with earthy tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or bright primary colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary line uses thick, blocky slab serifs with minimal stroke contrast
Secondary line uses a condensed, monolinear sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing (tracking) to create a solid block of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, colorful slab serif paired with a smaller, neutral sans-serif for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Text alignment to the top-left margin

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and blunt terminals.
Provides the 1970s editorial feel of the primary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with an afro and mustache wearing a 1970s plaid jacket over an orange vest. He is leaning forward with one hand reaching toward the camera in sharp focus. The background is dark and moody with a subtle floor shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned text in the top left corner. The first line should be a bold brick-red slab serif. The second line should be a smaller, mustard-yellow condensed sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the hand in the foreground noticeably larger due to perspective?
Is the text positioned in the upper-left quadrant?
Does the color palette consist of 1970s earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Pattern of the jacket (plaid vs. solid)
Specific hue of the red typography
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific name or title from the original image
Do not replicate specific brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic fabric textures (wool, cotton)
Ensure the reaching hand doesn't look distorted or AI-glitched
Verify the text is legible against the dark background
Confirm the 1970s period accuracy of the hair and clothing
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + foreshortened gesture + 70s wardrobe + top-left slab serif typography.
